title: Chromatic Ballet - Trio Weaknesses & How to Beat It
description: The Chromatic Ballet in Expedition 33 is three flying bosses in one, each with a different element. Blue, purple and orange weaknesses explained.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Chromatic Ballet is an optional boss in Falling Leaves - and it is actually three enemies in one encounter. Each is a differently coloured flying entity with its own element, its own weakness and its own resistance.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Ballet
sections.content:
Location: Falling Leaves, northwest of the Forgotten Battlefield (or southwest of Old Lumiere).

You need to complete the main story mission in Old Lumiere to gain Esquie's ability to swim through coral.

From the first Rest Point flag you can take either the high or the low path - both lead to the boss. It is at the end of the small Falling Leaves area, past the bridge.

It also appears in the Endless Tower (Stage 9 Trial 1).

sections.title: The Three Entities and Their Elements
sections.content:
The encounter is colour-coded. Position matters: blue is on the left, purple in the middle, orange on the right.

EntityWeak toResists
Blue (left)FireIce
Purple (middle)DarkLight
Orange (right)IceFire

Note the trap: Fire kills blue but is resisted by orange, and Ice kills orange but is resisted by blue. A single-element AoE approach will always be feeding one of them.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Blizzon
  • Resplendent Chroma Catalyst x6
  • Colour of Lumina x15

The Colour of Lumina x15 drop makes this one of the more worthwhile optional fights in Act 2.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Ballet
sections.content:
They all fly

The single biggest problem is that all three entities are airborne, which limits your melee options and makes positioning awkward. Expect to lean on ranged tools and free aim more than usual.

Switch targets, do not spread damage

Because each entity has a different weakness, the efficient approach is to focus one down at a time with the correct element rather than hitting all three with a single element type:

  • Take the blue one with Fire
  • Take the purple one with Dark
  • Take the orange one with Ice

This lets you avoid ever hitting something with an element it resists.
